entities.summary: Inaara Aga Khan is a German philanthropist. She was the second wife of Karim al-Husseini, who served as the 49th Imam of the Nizari branch of the Shia Imami Ismaili Muslims; from May 1998 to March 2014, she held the title Begum Aga Khan.
